_note: Hand-written stand-in for an agent's notes/diagnosis.json (toy example).
what_it_is: A puck on a table that is not level: a point mass with viscous friction, a constant pull towards +x and -y, and a random acceleration at every step.

mechanisms.name: M1 force
mechanisms.evidence: least squares over the 160 steps of trials 1 and 2, standard error 0.035

mechanisms.name: M2 friction
mechanisms.confidence: medium: assumed proportional to velocity; a constant part was not tested

mechanisms.name: M3 drift
mechanisms.evidence: same fit, standard errors 0.030 and 0.029; visible directly in trial 1, steps 0-9, with zero force

mechanisms.name: M4 puffs
mechanisms.evidence: standard deviation of the residual of the fit

different_from_hypothesis: The field note covers two things, not one: a constant drift (which a controller can cancel) and a random acceleration (which it cannot, and which decides whether the puck counts as at rest at the last step).

real_trials.purpose: scripted probe: pauses and single-axis pushes
real_trials.outcome: not a success, as expected for a probe

real_trials.purpose: scripted probe: both axes at once, opposite directions
real_trials.outcome: not a success, as expected for a probe
0.008 m from the target centre, still moving at 0.093 m/s: failure

controller: position gain 6 and velocity gain 3, set by hand for a well-damped response with the fitted gain and friction; constant force -drift/gain from the fitted parameters; tested in world.py: 182 of 200 episodes
